JOURNAL

To you, still listening

2026.09.16

Thank you for pressing play. Whether you clicked in because an algorithm recommended it, or because a friend mentioned this name — being heard by a stranger is actually a big deal for an independent artist.

Yu Stellar doesn't have impressive resources or a huge team behind it. A lot of the time it's just one person, one microphone, one laptop, recording what needs to be said late at night. So every play, every comment, is genuinely being heard.

If there's a song here that happens to catch some feeling you couldn't put into words, that's probably what music is for. I hope you'll stay, and keep listening.
